patch_description:
This version removes the unnecessary constraint that every point must remain on the unit sphere. The problem is only invariant under global translation and scaling, so points are instead centered and RMS-normalized after each update. This permits useful radial motion and possible interior-point configurations.

It uses a continuation objective based on smooth approximations to the logarithm of the minimum and maximum squared pair distances. Near the final continuation stages, it additionally constructs an active-contact force from pairs close to the current minimum and maximum distances. This directly expands limiting short pairs while contracting limiting diameter pairs. Multiple deterministic starts and small perturbations of strong symmetric seeds improve basin exploration while preserving reproducibility.
